description: This file defines a C# class 'Route' which interacts with JavaScript through Blazor's IJSRuntime to perform routing outside the application.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A class that provides a method to navigate outside the current route by invoking a JavaScript function asynchronously.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Asynchronously calls a JavaScript function to change the route to an external path.
